newsitem.title: USA: Gateway falls after earnings are in line.
newsitem.headline: Gateway falls after earnings are in line.

text.p: Shares of Gateway 2000 Inc fell on Friday after the company's first quarter earnings were in line with expections, after some investors were hoping its earnings would surpass expectations, analysts and traders said.

After climbing on Thursday along with other PC stocks, Gateway shares were off 4-1/2 to 53-7/8 in active trading. Gateway reported first quarter earnings of $0.86 a share, which was exactly the First Call consensus estimate.
"The market is basically punishing people for less than stupendous performance," said Louis Mazzucchelli, a Gerard Klauer Mattison analyst.
"Since the stock ran up yesterday, it's an excuse to take profits...In the world of high PC expectations, people look at this and say is that all there is?"
Mazzucchelli said that Gateway had a strong quarter, demand looks very good and that the company is "hitting on all cylinders."

A trader pointed out that Gateway participated in the run-up Thursday of several big cap technology stocks, after International Business Machines Corp's strong first quarter earnings, which highlighted strength in its PC unit.
